headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while others saw modest or slowing expansion.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% growth, the weakest among peers. Most companies highlighted AI contributions, but few disclosed concrete revenue figures. Profit growth varied, with HCLTech up 21% YoY and Wipro slipping 1.9% YoY.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI as a growth driver, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; Wipro introduced a modest sequential outlook, reflecting cautious market sentiment.

themes.title: Margin dynamics
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin target to 16%; operating margins varied from 14.8% at Tech Mahindra to 24% at TCS.
